gen-fs-oswald-gf-kumbh-sans: Oswald packs its rows in tight and low, a confident display voice. Kumbh Sans follows in sans-serif form, its terminals cut well short of the bowl, so paragraphs move along like lines from a fixed pen.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin reads clean and workmanlike, with a splayed c terminal that gives each line a slight kick. And Oswald is the one for strong, tightly knit headings, while the body font handles the steady running text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-meera-inimai: Compact and commanding, with lines packed close. Meera Inimai, a sans-serif with open-ended curves and a blueprint-lettering feel, keeps long paragraphs approachable, giving each line room to breathe.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-moderustic: Moderustic reads contemporary, its curves traced with a broad nib and left unfinished. And Oswald is the confident one, tightly knit and strong in headings, while the sans-serif body handles the sustained reading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans reads neutral and open, its letter openings as wide as a door left ajar. And Oswald, strong and tightly knit, does its best work big and short on top of that sans-serif.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-murecho: Murecho reads modern and clean, its s curves opening wide at both ends like a relaxed exhale. Oswald stands above it, tightly knit and confident, over a sans-serif body.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-nanum-gothic: Oswald is confident and strong, its rows tightly knit in a display voice. Nanum Gothic carries a long read in a contemporary sans, with wide channels leading into each counter so lines flow without strain.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-niramit: Oswald's tightly knit rows give it a confident, strong display punch. Niramit, a plain sans, has curves that look like they are gaping, which keeps extended reading clean and professional.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Oswald is strong and confident, with tightly knit rows of display text. Noto Sans Hatran, the sans-serif body, has a wide funnel-like throat in the e, which keeps a longer read neutral and approachable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Noto Sans Javanese is a plain sans, clean and neutral. Its apertures keep counters connected to the space outside, so extended reading stays unclogged while Oswald, tightly knit and confident, handles the headings.
